Name: Extra Map Actions (EMA)
Author: rokugin
Description:
[size=5][u]Install[/u][/size][size=3]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url].
2. Unzip the mod folder into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
﻿(optionally) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0.﻿

[/size][size=5][u]About[/u][/size][size=3]
This mod doesn't change anything on its own, it allows mod authors to use Content Patcher to add custom actions to TileData on maps in order to use actions that are normally locked to specific maps. Now with custom doors and fireplaces!

All available actions and properties are in the guide on GitHub.

[url=https://github.com/rokugin/ExtraMapActions/blob/main/docs/author-guide.md]Guide available on the GitHub[/url].[/size][size=3]

[/size][size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][size=3]
No currently known compatibility issues.
